title: One text field replaces short and long text, per-axle explained
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Settings - Service' enabled, on the build under test (template authoring).
  2. A template being edited; and an existing template built with the previous short-text and long-text fields.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm a single Text field replaces the separate short text and long text fields, and the field-type list offers one text option.
2. Confirm the Text field grows as the technician types rather than scrolling within itself.
3. Confirm templates built with the previous short/long text fields keep working unchanged, with nothing to migrate.
4. Open the Per axle field type's on-demand explanation and confirm it says one field covers the whole unit, the author picks which of the four measurement rows it carries, and the technician adds each axle while filling.
5. Open a Text field's settings and confirm there is no single-line or multi-line option.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • A single Text field replaces the separate short text and long text fields.
  • The Text field grows as the technician types rather than scrolling within itself.
  • The field type list offers one text option.
  • Templates built with the previous short text and long text fields keep working unchanged, with nothing for the author to migrate.
  • The Per axle field type carries an on-demand explanation: one field covers the whole unit, the author picks which of the four measurement rows it carries, and the technician adds each axle while filling.
  • The Text field has no single-line or multi-line option; it grows with the answer.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9110 (S12 — Template builder authoring); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S12; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S12-R20: “A single Text field will replace the separate short text and long text fields”
  • S12-R21: “The Text field will grow as the technician types rather than scrolling within itself”
  • S12-R22: “The field type list will offer one text option”
  • S12-R23: “Templates built with the previous short text and long text fields will keep working unchanged, with nothing for the author to migrate”
  • S12-R24: “The Per axle field type will carry an explanation on demand: one field covers the whole unit, the author picks which of the four measurement rows it carries, and the technician adds each axle while filling the inspection in”
  • S12-N4: “The Text field has no single-line or multi-line option; it grows with the answer”

Amended on 13 October 2026
S12-R24 changed on 7 October 2026 with SV-10877 (Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, read on 13 October 2026): the author picks which of the four fixed measurement rows the field carries. S12-N4 was not covered by any case; step 5 adds it. The quotes above are the current wording.

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
